task: Comprehensive modernization of CMS-V2 ingestion & integrity validation pipelines: PaddleOCR-VL (0.9B) parsing microservice, BAAI/bge-m3 1024-dim representations, and two-stage HybridSourceTracker (HST) with Winnowing re-ranking

evidence.modernization_verification_suite: passed (7/7 tests: BGE-M3 1024-dim, 8192 context, sparse lexical weights, HST formula, gating, end-to-end pipeline, OCR heuristics)

changes.plagiarism_engine/plagiarism_engine/conf: Configured BAAI/bge-m3, 1024-dim embedding schema, cms_documents_v2 collection, 8192-token context length, HST coarse top-K=50, calibrated weights (0.50/0.30/0.20), and 0.75/0.85 threshold bounds.
changes.plagiarism_engine/plagiarism_engine/embe: Upgraded EmbeddingModel to BAAI/bge-m3 with dual-backend support (FlagEmbedding + SentenceTransformers fallback), 1024-dim dense normalization, sparse lexical salience weights, and compute_sparse_similarity.
changes.plagiarism_engine/plagiarism_engine/data: Updated collection name to cms_documents_v2 and implemented query_candidates_with_scores for coarse ANN retrieval.
changes.plagiarism_engine/plagiarism_engine/hst_: Implemented two-stage HybridSourceTracker: Stage 1 coarse ANN candidate retrieval (top-50) + Stage 2 fine-grained Winnowing n-gram and sparse lexical re-ranking with calibrated composite scoring.
changes.plagiarism_engine/plagiarism_engine/main: Exposed POST /check-sync endpoint for real-time Node.js worker integration.
changes.ocr_engine/: Implemented standalone PaddleOCR-VL (0.9B) FastAPI microservice with PyMuPDF fast-path (<3 GB RAM envelope, 5-page GC batches, /health and POST /api/v1/parse-document).
changes.scripts/migrate_vectors_bge_m3.py: Created idempotent blue/green MongoDB + ChromaDB vector re-embedding backfill script.
changes.server/config/env.js: Added OCR_ENGINE_URL, OCR_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS, and PLAGIARISM_ENGINE_URL environment configurations.
changes.server/services/ocrExtraction.service.js: Implemented centralized Node.js OCR extraction gateway calling microservice with local fallback returning ocrStatus: degraded.
changes.server/jobs/plagiarism.job.js: Refactored worker to delegate primarily to Python HST /check-sync endpoint with in-process Node.js Winnowing fallback.
changes.docker-compose-v2.yml: Added modernized containerized stack preserving existing compose specs.

runbook.lesson: Upgrading vector dimensionality (384 -> 1,024) requires blue/green collection isolation (cms_documents_v2) so existing workloads remain operational during backfill, and two-stage candidate retrieval (top-50 ANN + exact Winnowing) reduces n-gram comparison complexity from O(N) to O(K) while catching localized edits.
runbook.prevention: Ensure all document reading and extraction modules implement graceful local fallbacks (degraded mode) when remote container microservices are cold-starting or unreachable.
